African Violet.description: Compact indoor plant with fuzzy leaves and bright violet/purple blossoms.
African Violet.care_summary: Water from bottom with room temperature water. Thrives in bright indirect light.

Aloe Vera.description: Fleshy, serrated succulent recognized for soothing gel and easy care.
Aloe Vera.care_summary: Thrives in bright direct sunlight. Water deeply but infrequently.

Anthurium.description: Glossy heart-shaped leaves featuring bright red or pink spathes.
Anthurium.care_summary: Keep in warm humid environment. Water when top inch of soil feels dry.

Areca Palm.description: Feathery, arching fronds creating a lush tropical aesthetic.
Areca Palm.care_summary: Provide bright indirect light. Keep soil slightly moist.

Asparagus Fern.description: Feather-like lacey green foliage with delicate arching stems.
Asparagus Fern.care_summary: Mist foliage regularly. Place in indirect light.

Begonia.description: Asymmetrical patterned foliage and colorful delicate blossoms.
Begonia.care_summary: Provide bright indirect light and well-draining potting mix.

Bird of Paradise.description: Large, dramatic banana-like leaves and majestic crane-like flowers.
Bird of Paradise.care_summary: Requires bright consistent direct sunlight and weekly watering.

Birds Nest Fern.description: Bright green wavy, crinkled fronds growing from a central rosette.
Birds Nest Fern.care_summary: Water around edges of central nest. Prefers medium shade and high humidity.

Boston Fern.description: Classic feathery sword-shaped fronds that trail gracefully.
Boston Fern.care_summary: Keep soil consistently moist and provide frequent humidity misting.

Calathea.description: Intricately striped or painted leaves that fold up at night.
Calathea.care_summary: Use distilled or filtered water. Keep in medium indirect light.

Cast Iron Plant.description: Extremely tough, dark green leathery leaves that tolerate low light.
Cast Iron Plant.care_summary: Allow soil to dry out between waterings. Extremely low-maintenance.

Chinese Money Plant.description: Pancake-shaped round coin leaves on slender upright stems.
Chinese Money Plant.care_summary: Rotate plant weekly for even leaf growth. Water when soil dries out.

Chinese Evergreen.description: Variegated silver, pink, or red leaves with low-maintenance needs.
Chinese Evergreen.care_summary: Tolerates shade and low light. Water when top 2 inches dry out.

Christmas Cactus.description: Flattened segmented green stems bearing bright magenta or red winter blooms.
Christmas Cactus.care_summary: Water thoroughly when soil surface feels dry. Avoid standing water.

Chrysanthemum.description: Classic potted flowering plant with dense ruffled colorful petals.
Chrysanthemum.care_summary: Needs bright sunlight and moist well-draining soil.

Ctenanthe.description: Oblong leaves with striking yellow and green marbling.
Ctenanthe.care_summary: Keep away from cold drafts. Maintain high humidity.

Daffodils.description: Bright trumpet-shaped yellow or white spring blossoms with slender leaves.
Daffodils.care_summary: Provide direct sunlight during blooming phase. Keep soil moist.

Dracaena.description: Slender woody trunks topped with arching ribbon-like leaves.
Dracaena.care_summary: Water sparingly. Sensitive to fluoride; use filtered water if possible.

Dumb Cane.description: Broad cream and dark green speckled leaves with tropical flair.
Dumb Cane.care_summary: Keep in bright indirect sunlight and wipe leaves occasionally.

Elephant Ear.description: Massive arrow-shaped glossy leaves with bold white or silver veining.
Elephant Ear.care_summary: Requires warm temperature, bright indirect light, and moist soil.

English Ivy.description: Classic trailing vine with lobed dark green leaves with lighter veins.
English Ivy.care_summary: Provide bright indirect light and cool room temperatures.

Hyacinth.description: Fragrant spike cluster flowers surrounded by narrow erect green leaves.
Hyacinth.care_summary: Keep cool while blooming. Water moderately.

Iron Cross Begonia.description: Pebbled green leaves with a distinctive chocolate-brown cross pattern.
Iron Cross Begonia.care_summary: Avoid overwatering. Provide bright indirect light.

Jade Plant.description: Thick woody stems bearing glossy oval succulent leaves.
Jade Plant.care_summary: Requires bright direct sunlight. Allow soil to dry out completely.

Kalanchoe.description: Thick fleshy scalloped leaves with long-lasting clusters of colorful flowers.
Kalanchoe.care_summary: Place in sunny location. Water sparingly.

Lilium.description: Large trumpet-shaped fragrant blossoms on tall unbranched leafy stems.
Lilium.care_summary: Place in bright indirect sun. Keep soil cool and moist.

Lily of the Valley.description: Sweetly scented bell-shaped white drooping flowers with broad leaves.
Lily of the Valley.care_summary: Thrives in partial to full shade with rich moist soil.

Money Tree.description: Braided woody trunk bearing palmate clusters of bright shiny green leaves.
Money Tree.care_summary: Water thoroughly when top 2 inches dry out. Prefers bright indirect light.

Monstera Deliciosa.description: Famous for its natural leaf fenestrations (holes) and vibrant tropical foliage.
Monstera Deliciosa.care_summary: Water every 1-2 weeks. Thrives in bright indirect sunlight and well-draining soil.

Orchid.description: Exotic long-lasting moth-like blossoms atop arching flower spikes.
Orchid.care_summary: Water with ice cubes or soak bark mix weekly. Requires bright indirect light.

Parlor Palm.description: Compact indoor palm with delicate feathery fronds thriving in shade.
Parlor Palm.care_summary: Adaptable to low light. Water when top inch of soil is dry.

Peace Lily.description: Dark green foliage producing elegant white spathe flowers.
Peace Lily.care_summary: Keep soil moist. Thrives in medium indirect light and high humidity.

Poinsettia.description: Iconic festive plant with bright red modified leaf bracts.
Poinsettia.care_summary: Place in bright indirect light away from cold drafts. Water when dry.

Polka Dot Plant.description: Compact foliage heavily splashed with pink, rose, or white spots.
Polka Dot Plant.care_summary: Pinch stem tips to encourage bushy growth. Needs bright indirect light.

Ponytail Palm.description: Swollen bulbous trunk topped with a fountain of long curling leaves.
Ponytail Palm.care_summary: Store water in bulbous trunk. Water sparingly every 3-4 weeks.

Pothos.description: Fast-growing trailing vine with heart-shaped leaves variegated with golden marbling.
Pothos.care_summary: Adaptable to low or bright indirect light. Water when soil feels dry.

Prayer Plant.description: Oval leaves with vivid red veins that fold flat together at night like hands in prayer.
Prayer Plant.care_summary: Keep soil consistently damp. Provide warm humid atmosphere.

Rattlesnake Plant.description: Wavy narrow leaves featuring dark green spotted patterns and purple undersides.
Rattlesnake Plant.care_summary: Keep out of direct sunlight to protect leaf patterns. Maintain humidity.

Rubber Plant.description: Broad, thick burgundy to dark green oval leaves with a shiny protective cuticle.
Rubber Plant.care_summary: Provide bright indirect light. Wipe leaves with damp cloth to remove dust.

Sago Palm.description: Feathery rigid dark green fronds growing in a symmetrical crown.
Sago Palm.care_summary: Bright light to direct sun. Allow soil to dry significantly between waterings.

Schefflera.description: Umbrella-like whorls of glossy green leaflets on woody stems.
Schefflera.care_summary: Provide bright indirect light. Prune to maintain shape.

Snake Plant.description: Hardy succulent with tall, upright sword-like variegated leaves.
Snake Plant.care_summary: Water sparingly every 2-3 weeks. Allow soil to dry out completely.

Tradescantia.description: Fast-growing trailing vine with purple, silver, and green striped foliage.
Tradescantia.care_summary: Provide bright light to preserve vibrant purple colors. Pinch stems.

Tulip.description: Classic cup-shaped spring flowers rising above smooth broad leaves.
Tulip.care_summary: Keep in cool sunny spot while flowering. Water moderately.

Venus Flytrap.description: Carnivorous plant featuring modified leaf traps edged with sensitive trigger hairs.
Venus Flytrap.care_summary: Use pure distilled or rain water only. Requires full sun and nutrient-poor soil.

Yucca.description: Sturdy cane trunk topped with stiff sword-like evergreen foliage.
Yucca.care_summary: Thrives in full bright sunlight. Extremely drought tolerant.

ZZ Plant.description: Glossy, dark green feather-shaped leaves with incredible drought tolerance.
ZZ Plant.care_summary: Tolerates heavy shade and low light. Water only when soil is completely dry.
